name: Baybrook Gateway
summary: Baybrook Gateway is a premier 241,152 square foot outdoor shopping center located at the Bay Area's dominant retail intersection in Webster, Texas. Adjacent to the recently expanded Baybrook Mall, this fully-leased center is home to top-performing national retailers serving Houston's affluent southern suburbs.
demographics: Baybrook Gateway serves a prosperous suburban Houston trade area with strong household incomes, particularly within the 5-mile radius where median household income reaches $99,200. The center attracts a diverse mix of middle to upper-middle class families and professionals from the Bay Area corridor, with the 10-mile trade area encompassing over 645,000 residents and 232,000 households. The demographic profile shows above-average income levels with many households earning $100,000-$200,000 annually, reflecting the area's strong employment base in aerospace, healthcare, and energy sectors. Shoppers are typically convenience-focused families seeking quality national retailers in an accessible outdoor shopping environment adjacent to the region's premier mall destination.
description: Baybrook Gateway stands as one of the Bay Area's premier shopping destinations, strategically positioned at the dominant retail intersection of the Houston-Webster corridor. This 241,152 square foot outdoor shopping center has established itself as a powerhouse retail location, home to some of the region's top-performing retailers who consistently rank among the best in their respective chains. The center's exceptional performance is bolstered by its prime location directly adjacent to Baybrook Mall, one of the Houston metropolitan area's leading shopping destinations that recently completed a massive 555,000 square foot expansion to serve the expansive and affluent trade area. With a parking ratio of 5.37 spaces per 1,000 square feet, Baybrook Gateway offers exceptional convenience and accessibility for shoppers throughout the Bay Area region. The center's success and desirability is evidenced by its fully leased status, with interested retailers joining a waitlist for future opportunities in this highly sought-after location that continues to serve the growing and prosperous Webster-Clear Lake community.
